sources.title: GitHub - quivent/autoawq-qwen35: Qwen3.5 (qwen3_5) support for AutoAWQ ...
sources.snippet: Adds qwen3_5 model support to AutoAWQ — enabling AWQ quantization of Qwen3.5-27B and its variants. Qwen3.5 has a hybrid architecture with alternating full-attention (standard transformer) and linear-attention (GDN/DeltaNet) decoder layers, plus vision encoder and MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) heads. This patch handles all of it.
